mechanism: Clarithromycin inhibits CYP3A4, reducing fexofenadine metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations, which may prolong QT interval and increase cardiac arrhythmia risk.
action: Consider alternative antibiotic (e.g., amoxicillin) or monitor ECG and QTc interval; if combination necessary, reduce fexofenadine dose or use non-sedating alternative antihistamine.
